metadata.title: MedOrbits Hostels Database
metadata.description: Structured hostel and accommodation information for institutions. Details are added only from official sources.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify availability, rules, facilities and charges with the institution or official hostel notice before publication.
metadata.recordPolicy: Do not create a hostel record until its institutionId can be matched to an existing institutions.id. Unknown values must remain null or empty arrays.
metadata.displayPolicy: Show verificationStatus and the availability disclaimer on every hostel detail view.

dataRules: Every hostel record must have a unique id and slug.
institutionId must reference an existing institution record in the institutions dataset.
Do not create records with fabricated institution IDs; if institutions data is unavailable, keep hostels empty until it can be reconciled.
feeIds, when set, must reference existing fee records with a hostel component.
countryCode must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
Never invent facilities, capacity, rules, contact details or availability; use null or an empty list when unknown.
A listed hostel does not guarantee a room; allotment depends on the institution's policy.
Contact details must come from the institution's official channels.
officialUrl must be HTTPS and point to the institution or its official hostel page.
sourceUrl should point to the official notice, handbook, fee circular, or institutional page supporting the record.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together; verified status requires sourceUrl.
Only use verificationStatus=verified after checking the supporting source and all displayed claims.
Unverified records must be labelled as unverified when displayed.
Safety, medical and anti-ragging information must be taken from official institutional or regulatory sources.
The active field controls display only; it does not indicate room availability.
Capacity must be a non-negative integer when known.
Do not infer gender policy from the institution name or student demographics.
Do not publish private personal contact details; use official institutional contact channels.
Review records when an official hostel notice, fee schedule, or institutional policy changes.
Do not display a fee as current unless its linked fee record has a current source and verification date.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm hostel availability and rules with the institution.
displayRules.disclaimer: Hostel details can change and availability is not guaranteed. Confirm with the institution before making decisions or payments.
